Waterman, Sheaffer, Parker, Paper Mate & Mixed Makers
Gold Tone & Two-Tone Metal Finishes

283353256.description:
Natural Quartz Crystal Cluster
Raw Mineral Specimen
Natural Clear Quartz, 31.4 Grams
Natural clear quartz crystal cluster specimen featuring multiple prismatic crystal points emerging from a common matrix base. Quartz (silicon dioxide) is one of the most widely recognized minerals in geological collecting, renowned for its hexagonal crystal habit, striations, and vitreous luster. This compact natural cluster displays attractive crystal growth and structure from multiple viewing angles.
Natural quartz crystal cluster specimen weighing 31.4 grams
Distinct hexagonal prismatic crystal formations with visible terminations
Interlocking crystal points anchored to a natural rough matrix rock base
Compact cabinet or pocket specimen size suitable for display or collection
Condition:
Natural geological specimen in raw, unpolished state. Crystal points display typical natural terminations with characteristic growth lines, internal inclusions, and surface textures inherent to formation. Matrix base is solid and stable for upright display.

Blue Calcite Raw Crystal Specimen
Natural Rough Mineral Display Stone
6.32 Lbs, 7.25 x 4.5 x 5.5 Inches
Natural raw blue calcite crystal specimen displaying dense crystalline formation with vibrant sky blue, soft periwinkle, and white banding throughout. Blue calcite is a calcium carbonate mineral sought by collectors for its pastel coloration, waxy luster, and natural cleavage planes. This substantial piece features a stable, natural standing profile well-suited for a centerpiece, desk display, or mineral collection.
Authentic natural raw blue calcite mineral specimen
Weight: 6.32 lbs

Natural crystalline cleavage texture with layered blue and white coloration
Condition:

Brazilian Agate Geode Bookend
Polished Natural Agate with Blue Enhancement
Mid-to-Late 20th Century Lapidary Decor
This natural Brazilian agate geode section has been cut and polished to highlight intricate concentric banding and a crystalline quartz core, enhanced with a vibrant blue dye treatment. Popularized during the mid-to-late 20th century as functional desk accessories and display specimens, cut geode bookends highlight organic geological formations alongside geometric lapidary craftsmanship.
Natural agate geode featuring fine banding surrounding a crystalline quartz center
Polished front face and upright surface with preserved natural rough rind on the exterior
Equipped with three protective green felt pads on the base to prevent surface scratching
Measures approximately 5 inches tall, 3.5 inches long, and 2.5 inches wide, weighing 2.1 lbs
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The polished faces display a smooth, lustrous finish with clearly defined banding. The rough exterior shows typical geological texture and variations inherent to natural stone formation. Base felt pads are intact. Free of chips, cracks, or damage beyond natural mineral characteristics.
